llm.summary: This design skill is a coherent guidance package with disclosed, limited preference storage and no executable or hidden high-impact behavior.

dimensions.detail: The only environment access described is limited to design-specific files under ~/Clawic/data/design/ for preferences, brand constraints, and memory.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is Markdown and metadata only; inspected files show no executable scripts, dependency installation, remote payload retrieval, or tool wrapping.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The activation scope is broad across design tasks, but it is aligned with the stated purpose and includes exclusions for design systems and brand strategy.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill reads and may update persistent design preference files, but the path is disclosed and writes are limited to preferences the user reveals during work.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently provide visual design rules for UI, pages, slides, graphics, email, charts, documents, typography, color, layout, dark mode, and accessibility.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, be aware that the skill can reuse and update design preferences under ~/Clawic/data/design/. Review those files if you do not want design choices or recurring feedback remembered across sessions.
llm.findings:
[P2] expected: The flagged HTML comments are placeholder prompts inside a memory template, not covert instructions to override the agent or perform unrelated actions.
[AR2] expected: The phrase 'don't apologize' appears in UI empty-state writing guidance and does not suppress safety warnings or refusal behavior.
[SQP-1] expected: The trigger description is broad, but it matches a general design-assistance skill and is bounded by stated exclusions.
[SQP-2] expected: Persistent preference files are real, but they are disclosed in SKILL.md/setup.md and scoped to design preferences, config, memory, and brand constraints.
